nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel that re-exports SessionService, PlanExecutionService, and their associated params/result types as the public entry point for SessionCore session operations.

nodes.name: PlanExecutionService.ts
nodes.summary: Provides PlanExecutionService, which turns an approved plan document or todo list into a chat message sent to a session's agent, wrapping the send in optimistic-turn tracking and retry logic.

nodes.name: SessionService.ts
nodes.summary: Singleton SessionService providing the unified session lifecycle API (create, list, status, send message, answer, interrupt, resume, cancel, merge, diff) shared by both the OS agent and human UI, dispatching through the Rust/Tauri backend.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for SessionService parameters and results (create, send message, merge, status, list) shared across the session action layer.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel exposing the unified session storage cache adapter and direct SQLite cache access for Rust-backed session persistence.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the rust-agent event handler context factory and event dispatcher used to process live agent WebSocket events.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Shared utilities barrel for agent session adapters: event type definitions, event factory builders, streaming/think-tag parsers, and subagent-spawn tracking helpers reused across adapters.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel exposing the Brick history client, shadow-read parity checker, and Tauri-backed Brick command runner used to validate Rust session history reads against the legacy path.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public entry point for the session-sync module: adapter registry types/functions, concrete agent/CLI adapters, and the SessionSyncProvider/useSessionSync hook that drive live event synchronization.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel exposing the loaded-turn registry (cache pruning) and the turn loader registry used to lazily hydrate session turn bodies into the store.

nodes.name: sessionGenerationGuard.ts
nodes.summary: Defines SessionGenerationGuard, a per-key generation-counter utility that lets async session-scoped work detect when it has been superseded by a newer invocation and safely abandon stale results.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a generation-ticket pattern (per-key counters plus isStale()/isCurrent() checks) rather than AbortController, so call sites are not required to actively check a signal.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting workspace-scoped Jotai atoms (session and UI state) migrated from the legacy React Context-based workspace contexts.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting workspace hooks (session and UI) that replace the former useSessionContext/useUIContext React Context hooks.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public entry point for the workspace module, re-exporting workspace-scoped Jotai atoms and hooks that replaced the legacy React Context implementation.

nodes.name: SimulatorAdapter.tsx
nodes.summary: Provides useSimulatorAdapter, a thin wrapper around the unified event renderer that gives Simulated Activities a backward-compatible renderEvent interface.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Pure-framework barrel for Simulator Apps: shared types, the app state hook, an app-type matcher, and the config factory used to define individual simulator apps.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public entry point for the Simulator Apps core framework, re-exporting types, matchers, and the state hook (the registry and renderer live elsewhere in WorkStation).

nodes.name: AskUserEvent.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the ask_user_questions simulator event: an animated input form for pending questions and a read-only completed view once responses are submitted.

nodes.name: AskUserPending.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the ask_user_pending simulator event as an animated 'incoming request' email notification while the user's response is awaited.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Displays a truncated single-line caption that expands into a portal-rendered Markdown panel positioned relative to configurable viewport bounds when clicked.

nodes.name: StationDockChrome.tsx
nodes.summary: Shared bottom-dock chrome for the My Station and Agent Station (simulator) views, handling auto-hide, debounced hover/focus expand-collapse, and an iPhone-style home pill layout.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: IDE-style file tab component (40px) showing a file-type icon plus a grayed directory and bold filename, used in file and code viewers.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Prop type definition for the FileTab component (file path, active/close state, click and close callbacks).

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Reusable Tab | Filter | List sidebar component (with a tab-free ListPanelContent body variant) supporting checkboxes, status badges, agent-selection indicators, and virtualization for lists over 50 items; used by the git status page and file operations IDE.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for ListPanelSidebar/ListPanelContent: tab config, list item shape (status badges, agent indicator), and content/sidebar prop interfaces.

nodes.name: sendPlanMessage
nodes.summary: Sends a plan-execution message to a session's agent via a raw Tauri invoke, beginning an optimistic turn immediately and failing it if the retried invoke throws.

nodes.name: assertSupportsManagedOperation
nodes.summary: Guards session-lifecycle operations (pause/resume/cancel/etc.) by throwing when the target session is an externally-managed history session that doesn't support them.

nodes.name: mapSessionToInfo
nodes.summary: Maps an internal Session record to the public SessionInfo shape (id, name, status, category, timestamps, pending question count) exposed to callers.

nodes.name: SessionGenerationGuard
nodes.summary: Per-key generation-counter guard: issues GenerationTicket objects that async session work can use to detect and abandon results superseded by a newer invocation for the same key.

nodes.name: useSimulatorAdapter
nodes.summary: Hook that wraps useUnifiedEventRenderer to give Simulated Activities a stable renderEvent function, acting as a drop-in replacement for the legacy useSimEventRenderer.

nodes.name: parseInputFields
nodes.summary: Parses the JSON-encoded input_fields event argument into a typed InputField array, returning an empty array on malformed input.

nodes.name: unwrapResult
nodes.summary: Unwraps a possibly-nested question response object or array to extract the underlying display value for the completed-answer view.

nodes.name: parsePath
nodes.summary: Splits a full file path into its directory portion and file name for separate styling in the FileTab label.

nodes.name: getStatusBadge
nodes.summary: Derives a status badge label and color class (modified/added/deleted/renamed/untracked) for a ListPanelItem, falling back to any explicit statusBadge override.

nodes.name: formatPath
nodes.summary: Splits an item path into directory and file-name segments for the two-tone secondary-text rendering used by list rows.

nodes.name: DefaultListItem
nodes.summary: Default row renderer for ListPanelContent: shows icon, name, secondary text, optional checkbox, status badge, and agent-selection indicator, with click handling that ignores checkbox clicks.

nodes.name: ListPanelContent
nodes.summary: Tab-free sidebar body: filter input with fuzzy substring matching, virtualized (Virtuoso) list rendering above a 50-item threshold, select-all checkbox handling, and empty/no-results/footer states.

nodes.name: ListPanelSidebar
nodes.summary: Adds a Tab | Filter | List header (TabPill row) around ListPanelContent, forwarding all content props through and exposing tab-change/width configuration.
